name: Zahublene bazhannya
source:
You are a new employee of the Timeless Archive. You have to arrange the new arrivals. However, the task turns out to be much deeper than it seemed at first glance.
Will you be able to complete your task or is it not important at all? Also, will you find out what the Timeless Archive actually is? And what desire do you have to remember?

[Translated from [url=https://orinoku.itch.io/lostwish]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是永恒档案馆的新员工。你必须安排新来的人。然而，事实证明这项任务比乍一看要深入得多。
你能完成你的任务还是它根本不重要？另外，你会知道永恒档案到底是什么吗？你必须记住什么愿望？

[译自[url=https://orinoku.itch.io/lostwish]itch.io[/url]]
